content:
jen.partnerships: Quick flag 1 Reseller partner Nimbus is blocked from Azure marketplace onboarding due to a PO escrow clause and mismatched signer. Can procurement + legal weigh in?
eli.procurement: Can you paste the exact PO clause? Treasury needs precise wording.
jen.partnerships: Here it is from their submission: `PO: Buyer shall remit 5% of PO value to Nimbus Escrow within 7 business days; escrow released on mutual acceptance.`
maya.legal: Mutual-acceptance release is risky. Recommend we request either (A) a 5% invoice holdback tied to our acceptance tests, or (B) an escrow addendum naming the escrow agent plus KYC and indemnity. Holdback is faster.
sam.sales: Nimbus says their marketplace ops require escrow for hardware SKUs in EMEA. Marketing wants launch next week. Any fast compromises?
violet-ps: Azure portal does not support third-party escrow on the PO type. They suggested an addendum or limiting flow to a private listing.
eli.procurement: Finance will accept a holdback + initial cap if we get an authorized signer and entity match.
vendor-bot: entity-match: signer="L. Ortiz (Nimbus Sales)"; registered="Nimbus Ltd."; EIN mismatch flagged. Require authorized officer signature or proof of delegation.
maya.legal: Proposed quick path: ask Nimbus to (1) accept 5% holdback on first invoice, (2) cap initial purchase at $40k, and (3) provide an authorized signer within 48h. If they agree, legal can clear immediately.
sam.sales: I'll request that now; asking for 48h turnaround.
jen.partnerships: Action items: Sam -> get amended PO with authorized signer and holdback acceptance, Eli -> confirm finance release cadence, Maya -> draft a short PO amendment template, Violet -> keep listing private until docs are done. I'll update marketing.
sam.sales: Noted, pinging Nimbus.
jen.partnerships: Thanks everyone. Will post vendor docs here when we get them. :thumbsup:
